newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Poor results fears spook Iscor shares.
newsitem.headline: Poor results fears spook Iscor shares.

text.p: Iscor shares fell to a new year low on Wednesday amid gloom over possibly worse-than-expected year results, dealers said.
The share cut 10 cents off its value to 3.20 rand in heavy volume of nearly 2.5 million shares.
"It's just talk and it's dismal. There's the feeling results are going to be even worse than was forecast," one dealer said.
"Many analysts are actually downscaling their forecasts."
Iscor told Reuters it had issued no profit warning on Wednesday. The iron and steel group announced poor interim results in February, but said the second half of the year would be better.
"It's obvious that no-one else thinks so," a dealer said.
Iscor's previous year low was 321 cents.
The company posted a half-year share of 6.5 cents from 17.6 cents previously.
